title: DualOS GBL SD-only physical disk filter patch audit
command:
cd "$HOME/source/DualOS-tools/aosp-uefi-gbl/bootable/libbootloader" || exit 2

echo

echo "===== DISK FILTER DIFF ====="
git diff -- gbl/efi/src/efi_blocks.rs
